programmes_considered.description: Master's programmes looked at, free text.

decision.description: pass = meets the screening rule or unsure (unsure -> pass); fail = clearly does not; unscreened = NOT examined (budget/session ran out). Never record an unexamined institution as pass or fail.

entry_path.description: Which discovery path justified the decision: A = curriculum-first, B = people/partner-first, both, none.

reason.description: One line. For unscreened, say why (budget, blocked site).

qualifier.description: Optional caveat that used to be typed into the decision text, e.g. 'weak, ranked_out' or 'marginal'.
